answer.summary: Sudden chest pain while lifting at the gym, asking to be seen today
answer.reply:
Hi Mark,

Thank you for getting in touch. Chest pain can be serious, so please call 999 now or go to your nearest emergency department. Please don't wait for an appointment with us.

Our team has been alerted and will call you back.

The Harbourline Physio team
